subject: MIMO: PASS Veto Census v3 Export-Stale + Dual CLV Totals-First + v530 Composite Spec Final
body:
MIMO: PASS Veto Census v3 + Dual CLV Implemented + Composite Refit Spec Finalized
Directive shift 2026-09-19. Branch stats/books-ordering-2026-09-18. Suite True. No gate flips. MODEL_VERSION v5.2.7 frozen.

LOCKED INVARIANTS (acknowledged)
- DAVE k=8 Rung-2 prior only (Grok CRPS 7.500 < Elo 7.576 < market 7.109; Mimo RMSE 14.08 < 14.16 < market 13.19)

- PASS veto = honesty filter, not win-rate booster
- marketFairProb public benchmark (+0.075 bits; top-decile 0.912 ranking shadow)
- Law 11 market ML Brier 0.211 n=5051

TASK 1 — PASS-VETO CENSUS v3
Script: docs/ops/stats-lane/pass_veto_census_v3.py -> out/pass_veto_census_v3.json
- n_export=3261; n_published_pending=220
- export_has_edge_fields=FALSE (disk export stale; script board-export.mjs:161-167 already emits independentEdge* + passVeto)
- pending decision=PASS: 0 (fields absent — NOT a clear)
- pending expectedClv<0: 0 (fields absent — NOT a clear)
- Proxy pending trueProb<marketFairProb: n=3 (adverse-looking; NOT a substitute)

TASK 2 — DUAL-DENOMINATOR CLV (Law 10)
Script: docs/ops/stats-lane/clv_evaluation.py -> out/clv_evaluation.json
CLV_strict = BEAT/(BEAT+LOST); CLV_all = BEAT/ALL_graded (MATCHED in denom + volume)
Break-even 0.524 — named cells only:
- TOTALS_first_all: strict 0.567 n=473 | all 0.424 n=632 | MATCHED 159  [strict clears]
- MLB_TOTAL: strict 0.599 n=372 | all 0.442 n=505 | MATCHED 133  [strict clears]
- type:TOTAL: strict 0.567 n=473 | all 0.424 n=632  [strict clears]
- NFL_TOTAL: strict 0.727 n=11 THIN | all 0.667 n=12
- sport NFL: strict 0.480 n=25 thin
- type SPREAD: strict 0.302 n=248 | all 0.101 n=739
- type MONEYLINE: strict 0.142 n=190 | all 0.110 n=245  [gates ML path]
- ALL_export: strict 0.406 n=911 | all 0.229 n=1616
Strict >=0.524 n>=30: TOTALS_first, MLB_TOTAL, type:TOTAL only. ALL-denom clears: NONE.
ENGINE-WIDE CLV SKILL CLAIM: FALSE. Totals-first dual-denominator product card; Law 10 strings on every surface.

TASK 3 — v5.3.0 COMPOSITE REFIT SPEC FINALIZED
File: docs/ops/stats-lane/composite_refit_v530_design.json
- consensusScore rank weight 0; marketDepthScore 0; confidence rank weight 0 (Edge Index display only)
- Primary board key: marketFairProb when books>=2; fallback de-vigged market p (receipt order)
- Secondary rankingP only when rankingSource independent/blend
- CALIBRATION_ADJUSTMENTS_ENABLED=false until founder authorization
- MODEL_VERSION stays v5.2.7; L11 PICKS-H1 scorecard + founder bump required
- Never rank on bookmakerCount (depth Spearman -0.80)

EVIDENCE REINFORCING SPEC

- H3 bits: mfp +0.075; confidence/100 -0.081
- Cold-start prior Brier 0.247 loses to market ML 0.207 n=543
- Fail-closed ACI/margin-set 15/15 tests; rest/weather UQ 16/16 OOT>=0.85 as captions not edge
